safe_corrective_action.HEALTHY_ENFORCING: Keep the protection fact attached to this token and send it to a separate council before any enforcement claim. This runtime does not load programs or change enforcement.
safe_corrective_action.HEALTHY_OBSERVING: Keep the observing fact distinct from an enforcement latch. This runtime does not enable enforcement.
safe_corrective_action.INTENTIONALLY_DISABLED: Leave the component disabled until an operator records a new explicit enablement decision. This runtime does not enable it.
safe_corrective_action.UNSUPPORTED: Leave the component marked unsupported. This runtime does not add a platform.
safe_corrective_action.PARTIAL_COVERAGE: Keep the named gaps on the record. Do not replace them with a coverage percentage. This runtime does not enroll workloads.
safe_corrective_action.DEGRADED: Read the limitation before any enforcement claim. This runtime does not restart a loader.
safe_corrective_action.STALE: Keep freshness UNKNOWN. Do not rewrite this state into freshness CURRENT. This runtime does not refresh a heartbeat file.
safe_corrective_action.DISCONNECTED: Keep this channel distinct from loader liveness. This runtime does not open a network connection.
safe_corrective_action.EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE: Collect the missing evidence fields before interpreting health. Do not substitute process up or HTTP 200.
safe_corrective_action.ENFORCEMENT_UNKNOWN: Do not report enforcement as healthy. Process up and HTTP 200 are not enforcement evidence. This runtime does not change Phantom Engine.
safe_corrective_action.ROLLBACK_INCOMPLETE: Leave the rollback marked incomplete until a separate verification records completion. This runtime does not run a rollback.
safe_corrective_action.UNINSTALL_INCOMPLETE: Leave the uninstall marked incomplete until a separate verification records completion. This runtime does not run an uninstall.
